answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a unique non-replicable compute resource verified by hardware attestation. The mechanism ties the stake to a private key and periodically challenges the agent to prove exclusive control, forcing an attacker to satisfy it separately for every fake identity. This costs the attacker the full price of multiple distinct machines plus energy, like cultivating separate walnut trees across an orchard instead of sharing one, pushing the economic horizon for profit beyond easy mass creation.
